simple.meaning: חֹרֶף (chôreph) appears 7 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Job, Psalms, Proverbs, Jeremiah, and 2 more, beginning at Genesis 8:22. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, kingship.

simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows חֹרֶף through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: חֹרֶף (chôreph) / H2779 is tracked through Genesis 8:22, Job 29:4, Psalms 74:17, Proverbs 20:4. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

structuredEvidence.definition: properly, the crop gathered , i.e. (by implication) the autumn (and winter) season ; figuratively, ripeness of age

evidence: Occurrence trail contains male relationship language

firstOccurrence.englishText: While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night will not cease.”

timeline.evidenceText: While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night will not cease.”
as I was in my prime,
You have set all the boundaries of the earth.
The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter;
Now the king was sitting in the winter house in the ninth month; and there was a fire in the brazier burning before him.
I will strike the winter house with the summer house;
It will happen in that day, that living waters will go out from Jerusalem: half of them toward the eastern sea, and half of them toward the western sea. It will be so in summer and in winter.

definitions.full: H2779. choreph חֹ֫רֶף noun masculine harvest-time, autumn (Arabic freshly gathered fruit, autumn (also rain of autumn or beginning of winter ) = Sabean (ןׅ חֿרפ DHM ZMG 1875, xxix. 597 ; Sabean חֿרפם חֿרף, = year , compare Ethiopic annus currens Os (Levy) ZMG 1865, 168, 174 DHM ZMG 1883, 369 ; Assyrian —arpu , Schr JPTh 1875, 341 KAT 253n. = COT i. 54 n .) — absolute ׳ח Zech 14:8 5 t.; suffix חָרְמִּי Job 29:4 ; — וָחֹרֶף קַיִץ Gen 8:22 (J), Psa 74:17 ; Zech 14:8 ; הַח ׳בֵּית autumn-house or palace Amos 3:15 ; Jer 36:22 (+ הַתְּשִׁיעִי בַּחֹדֶשׁ in the 9th month , i.e. Nov-Dec.); יַחֲרשׁ לֹא עָצֵל ׳מח Prov 20:4 a sluggard ploughs not after harvest ; as implying maturity, חָרְמִּי בִּימֵי Job 29:4 in the days of my autumn (prime).
